theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_dz_ofReal_im {φ : ℂ → ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 φ z) :
(dzbar (dz fun (w : ℂ) => ↑(φ w)) z).im = 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.fderiv_fderiv_ofReal {φ : ℂ → ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hφ : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 φ z) (u v : ℂ) :
((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ fun (w : ℂ) => ↑(φ w)) z) u) v = ↑(((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ φ) z) u) v)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_ofReal {φ : ℂ → ℝ} {z : ℂ} (hφ : DifferentiableAt ℝ φ z) :
dzbar (fun (w : ℂ) => ↑(φ w)) z = (starRingEnd ℂ) (dz (fun (w : ℂ) => ↑(φ w)) z)

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_dz_eq_dz_dzbar {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : ContDiffAt ℝ 2 f z) :
dzbar (dz f) z = dz (dzbar f) z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dz_dzbar_eq {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) :
dz (dzbar f) z = (((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) 1) 1 - Complex.I * ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) Complex.I) 1 + Complex.I * ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) 1) Complex.I + ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) Complex.I) Complex.I) / 4

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_dz_eq {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) :
dzbar (dz f) z = (((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) 1) 1 + Complex.I * ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) Complex.I) 1 - Complex.I * ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) 1) Complex.I + ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) Complex.I) Complex.I) / 4

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.hasFDerivAt_fderiv_apply {F : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] {f : ℂ → F} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z) (v : ℂ) :
HasFDerivAt (fun (z : ℂ) => (fderiv ℝ f z) v) ((fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ f) z).flip v) z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_mul_holo {f h : ℂ → ℂ} {h' z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) (hh : HasDerivAt h h' z) :
dzbar (fun (w : ℂ) => f w * h w) z = dzbar f z * h z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_const (c z : ℂ) :
dzbar (fun (x : ℂ) => c) z = 0

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_const_mul {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) (c : ℂ) :
dzbar (fun (w : ℂ) => c * f w) z = c * dzbar f z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dz_const_mul {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) (c : ℂ) :
dz (fun (w : ℂ) => c * f w) z = c * dz f z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_add {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z) :
dzbar (fun (w : ℂ) => f w + g w) z = dzbar f z + dzbar g z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dz_add {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z) :
dz (fun (w : ℂ) => f w + g w) z = dz f z + dz g z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_sub {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z) :
dzbar (fun (w : ℂ) => f w - g w) z = dzbar f z - dzbar g z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dz_sub {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) (hg : DifferentiableAt ℝ g z) :
dz (fun (w : ℂ) => f w - g w) z = dz f z - dz g z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_comp_holo {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {g' z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (g z)) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' z) :
dzbar (fun (w : ℂ) => f (g w)) z = dzbar f (g z) * (starRingEnd ℂ) g'

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dz_comp_holo {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {g' z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (g z)) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' z) :
dz (fun (w : ℂ) => f (g w)) z = dz f (g z) * g'

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.hasFDerivAt_comp_holo {f g : ℂ → ℂ} {g' z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f (g z)) (hg : HasDerivAt g g' z) :
HasFDerivAt (fun (w : ℂ) => f (g w)) ((fderiv ℝ f (g z)).comp (ContinuousLinearMap.restrictScalars ℝ (ContinuousLinearMap.smulRight 1 g'))) z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dz_of_hasDerivAt {f : ℂ → ℂ} {f' z : ℂ} (h : HasDerivAt f f' z) :
dz f z = f'

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dzbar_eq_zero_iff {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} (hf : DifferentiableAt ℝ f z) :
dzbar f z = 0 ↔ DifferentiableAt ℂ f z

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.dz_dzbar_of_hasFDerivAt {f : ℂ → ℂ} {z : ℂ} {L : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ} (h : HasFDerivAt f L z) :
dz f z = (L 1 - Complex.I * L Complex.I) / 2 ∧ dzbar f z = (L 1 + Complex.I * L Complex.I) / 2

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.fderiv_eq_dz_add_dzbar (f : ℂ → ℂ) (z v : ℂ) :
(fderiv ℝ f z) v = dz f z * v + dzbar f z * (starRingEnd ℂ) v

theorem QOU.MathlibExt.Dolbeault.rlinear_eq (L : ℂ →L[ℝ] ℂ) (v : ℂ) :
L v = (L 1 - Complex.I * L Complex.I) / 2 * v + (L 1 + Complex.I * L Complex.I) / 2 * (starRingEnd ℂ) v
